entries.2edd87e85679c2e3: This business collects and transports metal scrap and waste discharged from factories and demolition sites, and at intermediate treatment plants carries out shearing and cutting, manual dismantling, crushing and sorting, and compressing and solidifying to produce recycled resources such as ferrous scrap, non-ferrous metals, plastics and rubber, which it sells in Japan and overseas. Consolidated subsidiaries Econeco and Nitto Kako, and equity-method affiliates Abizu and Fuji Eco Cycle, among others, are responsible for this business.
